answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 135 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the summit log shows the live set and the nadir audit records each lapse. Keeping 273 aliases alive thus means 273 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the garden quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 8 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
